headline: New staging bucket has no public-access block; user-uploaded content could be exposed if a policy or ACL is later misconfigured.
suppressed: Lifecycle expiry of 1 day with an empty filter correctly covers all objects as intended; no versioning or replication concern because the bucket is designed as transient scratch space.

findings.evidence_ref: data_stores.tf: aws_s3_bucket.tmp_uploads is added with no accompanying aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource
findings.explanation: Without an explicit public-access block, an inadvertent bucket policy or ACL change could make browser-uploaded files publicly readable; the existing artifacts bucket pattern should be followed by adding a block_public_acls/block_public_policy resource for this bucket.
